environment.postgres: PostgreSQL 17.11 on x86_64-pc-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit

topSqlByTime.query:
select a.tenant,m.space from saas_actors a
				join saas_memberships m on m.actor=a.id and m.active
				join saas_bindings b on b.actor=a.id and b.space=m.space and b.active and b.expires>now()
				join saas_roles r on r.id=b.role and r.permissions @> array[$2,$3]
				where a.id=$1 and a.active

select count(*) from "saas_tasks" where ((("saas_tasks"."tenant" = $1 and "saas_tasks"."space" in ($2, $3, $4, $5)) and "saas_tasks"."tenant" = $6) and ("saas_tasks"."tenant" = $7 and "saas_tasks"."space" in ($8, $9, $10, $11)))

select "id", "tenant", "space", "title", "status", "body", "revision", "id", "created_at", "updated_at" from "saas_tasks" where ((("saas_tasks"."tenant" = $1 and "saas_tasks"."space" in ($2, $3, $4, $5)) and "saas_tasks"."tenant" = $6) and ("saas_tasks"."tenant" = $7 and "saas_tasks"."space" in ($8, $9, $10, $11))) order by "saas_tasks"."updated_at" DESC limit $12
select a.id from saas_sessions s join saas_actors a on a.id=s.actor where s.token=$1 and s.expires>now() and a.active

with recursive ancestors as (
			select id,parent_id,deleted from saas_pages where id=$1 and tenant=$2 and space=any($3::int[])
			union select p.id,p.parent_id,p.deleted from saas_pages p join ancestors a on p.id=a.parent_id
		) select count(*)>$4 and not bool_or(deleted) as allowed from ancestors
select id,tenant,space,title,status from saas_tasks where tenant=$1 and space=any($2::int[]) order by updated_at desc,id limit $3

insert into "questpie_realtime_log" ("seq", "txid", "resource_type", "resource", "operation", "record_id", "locale", "payload", "created_at", "settled_at") values (default, default, $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, default, default) returning "seq", "txid", "resource_type", "resource", "operation", "record_id", "locale", "payload", "created_at", "settled_at"

select "seq", "txid", "resource_type", "resource", "operation", "record_id", "locale", "payload", "created_at" from "questpie_realtime_log" where ("questpie_realtime_log"."txid" < pg_snapshot_xmin(pg_current_snapshot()) and ("questpie_realtime_log"."txid", "questpie_realtime_log"."seq") > ($1::text::xid8, $2::bigint)) order by "questpie_realtime_log"."txid" asc, "questpie_realtime_log"."seq" asc limit $3
select count(*) from "saas_tasks" where "saas_tasks"."id" = $1
update "saas_tasks" set "body" = $1, "revision" = $2, "updated_at" = $3 where "saas_tasks"."id" in ($4)
